title_ar: الشيخ الددو في زيارة أخوية للدكتور أنور ابراهيم
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew on a Fraternal Visit to Dr Anwar Ibrahim
body_ar:
أدى صباح اليوم الاثنين 30 يوليو 2018م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء و رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين بموريتانيا – حفظه الله تعالى – زيارة أخوية وعيادة للدكتور أنور إبراهيم نائب رئيس الوزراء الماليزي السابق وعضو الائتلاف الحكومي الحالي

وكانت الزيارة مناسبة للاطمئنان على الحالة الصحية للدكتور بعد أن أجرى عملية جراحية - ناجحة و لله الحمد - في أحد المستشفيات في العاصمة التركية اسطنبول، و كما كانت فرصة لاستعراض مختلف قضايا الأمة الإسلامية وهمومها.

وختم فضيلة الشيخ الزيارة بالدعاء للدكتور أنور إبراهيم بالشفاء وللأمة الإسلامية بالنصر والرخاء والتمكين.
body_en:
On the morning of Monday 30 July 2018, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University in Mauritania (may God the Exalted preserve him), paid a fraternal visit, and a sick visit, to Dr Anwar Ibrahim, former deputy prime minister of Malaysia and a member of the present governing coalition.

The visit was an occasion to make sure of the doctor's state of health after he had undergone an operation — a successful one, praise be to God — at one of the hospitals in the Turkish capital Istanbul; and it was likewise an opportunity to review the various questions of the Islamic community and its concerns.

His Eminence closed the visit by praying for Dr Anwar Ibrahim's recovery, and for the Islamic community: for victory, prosperity and establishment in the land.

flags.context: the closing prayer of the visit
options: for the Islamic community: for victory, prosperity and establishment in the land
for the Muslim community: victory, prosperity and empowerment
for the Islamic nation: triumph, prosperity and ascendancy
flags.note: تمكين is the Qur'anic term for God's establishing a people firmly in the land and giving them authority there. 'Empowerment' is the usual modern rendering but has acquired other associations in English; 'ascendancy' would strengthen it into a political claim. Rendered with the Qur'anic sense. The clause is a customary closing supplication, not a political programme, and should not be excerpted as one.

translator_notes: عيادة is the visiting of a sick person; rendered 'a sick visit' alongside 'fraternal visit', since the Arabic gives both.

The record was published in July 2018, when Anwar Ibrahim was a member of the governing coalition in Malaysia but not yet prime minister; the English keeps the description the source gives and does not update it.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, but here it matches the date the body gives for the visit.
